m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: What do you think you're doing interrupting me? Oh, hey, you're that Wizard I fought earlier. You're alright. So what do you need?
A Nimbari group is riling up Myth Monsters? Nimbari and their politics. You know, our ancestors left Athanor to get away from all that.
The Mythies ain't new; Paradox Chain been spittin' 'em out forever. But they're getting meaner. And I hear of new horrors that ought not to be.
The Nimbari said they sent a squad to help us? My sweet Aunt Gladys they did! Josiah's been up there for weeks asking for that.
Told 'im it was pointless. Aero Dwarves gotta solve our own problems. That said, I ain't too proud to turn down aid when it walks right up to me.
So go see the Mythie problem firsthand. I gotta Smith named Tyler patching up Storm Turbine A. Old coot probably needs help.
What?  Turbine? I'm working on it. Hang on, you're not a Nimb or a dwarf. You a Mythie? Wait a tick, let me get my hittin' wrench.
Oh, Quill sent you? Bah, whipper-snap thinking I need help. Well, what do you know about Storm Turbines? Nothing? Figures.
The Turbines use the winds of the Aero Plains to power giant targeting mirrors in the sky what reflect Storm Energy from here toward Nimbus.
It's a win-win. We get the only clear skies in Empyrea and they use the massive amounts of Storm Energy to power their Citadel and weapons.
Only problem is Meowls love tearing the shiny bits off the power circuits. Now I have to keep patching said circuits so the Turbine don't fail...
...Which would cause the storms to return and destroy us all. So... I guess I could use a hand. Go get them shiny Turbine Bits from the Meowls.
Did you get the Turbine Bits? Good. They should snap back into place easily enough. Take care of it quick while I hold the circuit steady.
That oughta keep the storms at bay. But them Meowls are still a problem. You heard the Myth Monsters are getting more aggressive, yeah?
Well, the farmers out this-a-ways have been spinning yarns about a mega-critter called the Neumian Lion that's been revving 'em up.
Young people! Oh, sorry. But the Neumian Lion's a ghost story, literally the stuff of nightmares. It can't be real. Can't be.
Still, something's making the Meowls crazy. And I've been seeing lots of tracks heading toward Turbine B. Walk this way.
Get back! Tyler's got a wrench. Oh, it's just you, Wizard. Anyway, ready for the hard part?
What's that thing? Streamportal, huh? Enables travel through dematerialization, you say? Well, I prefer flying myself. I'm usually better at it.
Now, about your mission. You say your friend was captured by this Dark Cloud group. Can't say as I know where they are.
If they're tied to the ornery Myth Monsters, though, investigating those is a good place to start.
I've been waiting in Nimbus so long, my information's probably out of date. So talk to Mayor Quill. See what he knows.
Oh, the party? Don't worry about that. We do this every week. Quill won't mind the interruption.
To find your friend, you need to start by finding the cause of the Myth Monster trouble. Mayor Quill will know more.
